units.source_text: “当然，在这个国家这也是个丑闻。

en.t: Of course, in this country this is a scandal too.

units.source_text: 但只要本人坦然承认，那么就没人会把它当成丑闻了。

en.t: But as long as the person concerned openly admits it, no one will treat it as a scandal anymore.

units.source_text: 哲学家马咯说过：‘错不讳言，何错之有。’

en.t: The philosopher Magg once said, 'If one does not hide a fault, where is the fault in it?'

units.source_text: ……再说我除了赚钱之外，还有满腔的爱国热情呢。”

en.t: Besides, apart from making money, I am also full of patriotic fervor.
